title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：silk　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 silk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the tailor ① weaved the silk that no customer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the weaving was the whole of the week. The ② silk, meaning the fabric itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; silk, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of silk in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ silk at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Silk, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the tailor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the silk was the whole of the matter, meaning the elegance and not the fabric. The ⑥ silk, meaning the elegance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; silk, he said, is either something you weave or the only word that means both fabric and an elegance. He said the elegance is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ silk had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ silk of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of recording; silk, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ silk I remember is the silk recorded in the order, which closed in 1988 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. ⑩ Silk, my mother said in 1990, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all silk, she said, is an elegance that has agreed to look like fabric. She said the elegance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 丝绸（指裁缝铺里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 丝绸（指那匹丝绸本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：weave the silk 织这一匹丝绸
D. n. 丝绸（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 丝绸之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的丝绸之事）
F. n. 丝绸（指订单簿里写到、被记载的那一匹）
G. n. 丝绸、讲究（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 讲究（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: weaved the silk that no customer in the shop would have recorded
The silk, meaning the fabric itself and not the needle
Every sort of silk in that shop
the silk at the far mirror
the silk was the whole of the matter
the silk had become a line in an order
The silk of the whole thing

answers.why: weave the silk 意为“织这一匹丝绸”，1981 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯记载的一匹丝绸做了一遍。
silk 意为“丝绸”，指那匹丝绸本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
silk 意为“丝绸”，指裁缝铺里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
silk 意为“丝绸”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
silk 意为“丝绸、讲究”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这匹讲究就是那件事的全部。
silk 意为“讲究”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那匹丝绸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
silk 意为“丝绸”，指订单簿里写到、被记载的那一匹，到 1986 年这一匹成了订单簿里的一行。
silk 意为“丝绸之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的丝绸之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的记载。
silk 意为“丝绸”，我记得的是订单簿里记载过的那一匹，1988 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一匹。
silk 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，丝绸是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的丝绸。
